__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Hercynia, Seconded: Semmerholm">To construct Last Battle Wayhouse in the Bleaks, the Barrens. The Wayhouse will be a vital strategic tool in our fight against the Druj, providing crucial reconnaissance into Sarangrave. Appointed annually by Generals of Navarr. Self funded.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a wayhouse in the Bleaks, the Barrens as per the '''[[The_way_home#The_Last_Battle|The way home]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed

==Date==
* Autumn 386YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 18 weirwood
* 54 crowns
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Last_Battle_Wayhouse}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the [[Keeper of the Last Battle]] will be available to appoint by unanimous decision of the generals of [[Navarr]] for the first time at the Winter Solstice 386YE. Nesustak Forest and Turan Flats in [[Sarangrave]] have both gained the [[Region_qualities#Under_Threat|under threat]] quality. As a wayhouse it also allows Navarri characters to have personal resources in the Barrens, benefiting from any [[great work|great works]] in the territory and will increase seasonal taxation from the Barrens by one throne.
